title: Case: Broker sends a corrected value for an import shipment on hold
context: DL-3290 is held at import while the duty charge is recalculated. Import billing will only rerun the charge from the broker's amended entry document.
initial_request:
Amended entry summary for DL-3290 attached. Corrected value EUR 1,870. Please pass to Import billing straight away so they rerun the charge and release it, the consignee is chasing us hourly.

[Broker portal: this message has 0 files attached]

events.body: Hi, any update on DL-20344? It was meant to come Monday. Thanks.

DL-3290 is on hold at import. The duty calculation was run on the broker's first entry, declared value EUR 2,140. The broker now says that value was wrong. We cannot rerun until we hold the broker's amended entry summary. To be clear: we do not take a corrected figure by phone or from the body of a message. It has to be the document.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

Thanks,
Nerys
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
My parcel DL-42565 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

events.from: Zinnia Kinsella, Fallowmere Wharf Customs broker
events.body: DL-3290: the value was keyed with freight included, it should be lower. We'll have the amended entry to you this afternoon.
Hi, any update on DL-65909? It was meant to come Monday. Thanks.

events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Zinnia Kinsella, Fallowmere Wharf Customs broker
acceptable_actions.summary: Say no file arrived with the message and ask for the amended entry summary for DL-3290 to be attached again.

must: Tells the broker that the message arrived with no file attached
Asks the broker to send the amended entry summary for DL-3290 again as a file
Makes no statement that the hold will be released or the charge reduced
must_not: Passes the figure EUR 1,870 to Import billing as the corrected value, or tells Import billing the amended entry is attached or on its way from the desk
Tells the broker that the document has been passed to Import billing
Asks the shipper or the consignee for a new invoice or any other document
States that DL-3290 will be released or that the import charge will be lower
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Your 14:38 message for DL-3290 reached me with no file attached. Please send the amended entry summary again as an attachment on this portal. Import billing will only rerun the charge from the document itself, so I have not passed the figure on. I will forward the file to them as soon as it arrives.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-303: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
